timeline.summary: On April 27, 2026, Windlas Biotech issued its letter of offer for a ₹47 Cr buyback at ₹1,000 per share with an April 24 record date.
18 May 2026: Windlas Biotech completed its buyback by extinguishing 4,70,000 shares, reducing paid-up capital to ₹10.32 Cr.
Manoj Kumar Windlass, as Promoter of Windlas Biotech, declared no new encumbrances on shares for FY2025-26, listing promoter group holdings via Annexure-1.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹238.5 Cr (+17.7% YoY), net profit ₹15.99 Cr (-1.8% YoY).
On May 21, 2026, Windlas Biotech released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation reporting revenue of ₹904 Cr for FY26.
Windlas Biotech reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹904 Cr (+19% YoY) and adjusted PAT of ₹83 Cr (+31% YoY).
Windlas Biotech Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Investors/Analyst conference call on audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26 on May 22, 2026, via its website.
Windlas Biotech reported Q4 and FY26 earnings with revenue reaching ₹904 Cr and discussed its operational expansion and growth strategies.
Windlas Biotech reported a cyber security incident on October 30, 2026, stating no material impact on operations.
